COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Intercultural Competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence.
   B. Treat Intercultural Competence as rumours only.
   C. Say Intercultural Competence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Intercultural Competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)

   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
